messages:
Maya Patel: quick pass on the release notes draft for the 'slate' relnotes. I bumped known-issues and added migration snippet for SDK v1->v2.

Kevin Cho: thanks — can you paste the snippet here? want to sanity-check code sample formatting

Maya Patel: sure — here's the snippet:
```
# Python SDK v2 migration
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/kestrel:latest', prompt='Hello')
print(resp.text)
```

Samir Gupta: small nit: `resp.text` is changed to `resp.output.text` in v2. also we should call out streaming behavior change.

Maya Patel: good catch. updated. also added a short note under 'known issues' about embedding dimensionality mismatch when migrating cached indexes.

Olivia Chen: linkcheck: the snippet references `redwood/kestrel:latest` which we don't host in the docs model registry page — can you link to /docs/models/kestrel instead?

Maya Patel: done. also fixed a broken anchor to 'token accounting' that the linter flagged.

docs-bot: lint check complete — 3 warnings remain: code-block lang missing (line 12), relative link to /contribute/docs not found, missing changelog tag.

Kevin Cho: i'll pick up the relative link, it's from the migration guide template. assign to me.

Kevin Cho: assigned. ETA EOD PST.

Samir Gupta: QA note: please add a quick eval result for the example prompt. tiny table with before/after latency would be great.

Maya Patel: added a one-line table for median p95 latency for both SDKs.

Olivia Chen: will run linkcheck after Kevin's fixes.

Kevin Cho: pushed a small PR: 1778004422 — fixes relative link and code block language. Also updated doc frontmatter with `changelog: [[slate]]`

Maya Patel: thanks — can someone run the relnotes generator and confirm the slate tag surfaces in the site output?

Samir Gupta: i'll run generator now: `make gen-relnotes ENV=staging` — sending logs in a sec.

Samir Gupta: logs: generation completed, slate tag appears in /_site/relnotes/index.html, but one anchor mismatch: `#sdk-migration` -> actual anchor `#sdk-migrations` (plural)

Maya Patel: fixed anchor in the source. re-run please.

Samir Gupta: re-run ok. staging build 1778004560 shows updated relnotes and correct anchors. docs-bot: deploy check queued.

Olivia Chen: planning to merge after CI passes. any other blockers?

Kevin Cho: none from my side.

Maya Patel: no blockers. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
